raw_prompt: !create boots that change the block under me to diamonds when I walk over them. Diamond boots
reviewer_feedback: Created Diamond Walker Boots that transform specific ground blocks into diamond blocks when walked upon.
usage_instructions: Use /givewalkerboots to receive the special diamond boots.
Equip the boots and walk on stone, dirt, grass, sand, or gravel.
The blocks beneath you will instantly turn into diamond blocks.

mutations.content:
on player move:
    if player's boots is diamond boots named "&bDiamond Walker Boots":
        set {_b} to block below player
        if {_b} is stone or dirt or grass block or sand or gravel:
            set block at {_b} to diamond block

command /givewalkerboots:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give 1 of diamond boots named "&bDiamond Walker Boots" with lore "&7Walk on air and turn blocks to diamond" to player

traces.intent_summary: Create diamond boots that transform blocks beneath the player into diamond blocks while walking.

traces.rationale: I implemented a 'walk' event listener that checks for the specific custom-named diamond boots. I restricted the block replacement to common natural blocks (stone, dirt, etc.) to prevent accidental destruction of player-built structures or essential utility blocks. A command is provided to obtain the item.

traces.rationale: The error 'on walk on any block' is not a valid Skript event. The correct approach is to use the 'on player move' event and check the player's boots slot. I have implemented a check for specific block types to prevent accidental world destruction and provided a command to obtain the item.
